_comment: Values for THIS parking form. Keys are the question labels exactly as they appear on the form — the bot reads the live form and resolves each label to its entry.XXXX id automatically, so you never copy ids. Values support {{DATE+1:MM/DD/YYYY}} etc. (evaluated in PARKING_TZ). Replace every value below with your real info, then paste the whole JSON into the PARKING_FIELDS secret. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
